ndlt.rationale: Engine-internal DDL/planner/allocator consumer; absence of application field reads is not evidence of unused storage. Measured snapshot: 612 rows, 612 non-NULL and 0 NULL; distinct non-NULL 599 (exact). Population corroborates only this installation, not product-wide feature use or retirement eligibility. See [per-column statistics](statistics.md#sqlite_stat4).
